title: Replace record dicts with a dataclass across a package and its tests
prompt: The ledger package passes entries around as plain dicts built by make_entry(). Replace them with a frozen dataclass named Entry in ledger/models.py, with the fields description (str), amount (Decimal) and category (str, default "misc"). Entry must still convert amount to Decimal and reject an empty description with ValueError, as make_entry does now. Remove make_entry (no alias); callers build Entry(...) directly. Change every module and the tests from entry["..."] subscripts to attribute access, and export Entry from ledger/__init__.py instead of make_entry. Behaviour stays the same. Keep the tests passing.
